summary: This Wikipedia list covers the cast of the American soap opera The Young and the Restless, created by William J. Bell and Lee Phillip Bell for CBS and first aired on March 26, 1973. It highlights the longest-running cast members, including Doug Davidson, Jeanne Cooper, Melody Thomas Scott, Eric Braeden and Kate Linder. The list is limited to cast members currently on the show, including main and recurring members as well as those debuting, departing or returning.
one_line: A Wikipedia list of current and recent cast members of the CBS soap opera The Young and the Restless, with longest-running actors.
key_facts: The Young and the Restless is an American television soap opera created by William J. Bell and Lee Phillip Bell for CBS.
The Young and the Restless first aired on March 26, 1973.
Doug Davidson is the longest-running current cast member, having portrayed private investigator Paul Williams since May 23, 1978.
Jeanne Cooper portrayed the soap opera's matriarch Katherine Chancellor and holds the record for the series' longest-running cast member.
Jeanne Cooper aired on the series from November 1973 until her death in May 2013.
Melody Thomas Scott, who portrays Nikki, joined the cast in February 1979 and is the second longest-running cast member.
Eric Braeden, who portrays Victor Newman, joined the cast in February 1980 and is the third longest-running cast member.
Kate Linder has portrayed Esther Valentine since April 1982 and rounds out the series' top four longest-running cast members.
The list covers cast members who are currently on the show, both main and recurring members.
The list also includes cast members who are debuting, departing or returning from the series.
